title: review: R18: CLI wiring — scorecard --scheduling and --strategies, orchestrator explain <task>, orchestrator promotion, plus README rows
spec:
Why: sched_scorecard, strategy, decision_log and promotion merged as modules with format functions but no command exposes them (orchestrator/cli.py:124-166 scorecard flags, subparsers).
What (orchestrator/cli.py, README.md; Tests: this repo runs unittest; every acceptance test id is a `def test_name(self)` method inside a unittest.TestCase subclass in the named file; no pytest fixtures; use the daemon test harness in tests/_harness.py.): scorecard gains --scheduling (sched_scorecard.build/format) and --strategies (strategy.scorecard/format) as mutually exclusive with the existing flags (extend the existing exclusivity check and error text); new subcommands `explain <task>` (decision_log.explain + format_explain, --json) and `promotion` (promotion.report + format_report, --json); README pipeline table gets one row per new command. Every new command supports --json where the others do.
acceptance: tests/test_cli.py::test_cli_scorecard_scheduling_and_strategies_text_and_json — both flags print the formatted card and valid JSON with --json, and combining two scorecard flags errors with the extended message
tests/test_cli.py::test_cli_explain_prints_decision_rows — explain <task> prints format_explain lines and --json emits the rows
tests/test_cli.py::test_cli_promotion_report — promotion prints one line per feature and --json emits the report

result.summary: Verified against the actual commit (1696f0d): sched_scorecard.build/format, strategy.scorecard/format, decision_log.explain/format_explain, and promotion.report/format_report signatures all match their call sites in cli.py. Argparse wiring is correct (shared 'cmd' dest, no name collisions). Ran the full tests/test_cli.py suite (24 tests) plus the three named acceptance tests individually — all pass. README table addition matches scope. No security concerns: no user-supplied input reaches file paths or shell execution.
